 "evidence": "Three demos and a successful test showed each 2 embedded in a 3 panel recolors its 3×3 neighborhood to 1, even where the halo overlaps zeros; 2s remain unchanged and outside markers are ignored.",
 "proposal_content": "---
name: arc-marker-halo-recolor
description: Solve ARC grids with solid color-3 panels containing scattered color-2 markers; recolor each marker’s 3×3 halo.
---

# ARC marker halo recoloring

1. Identify each large rectangular panel made of color 3, allowing color-2 markers to interrupt its fill; treat a 2 as a panel marker only when it lies within that panel’s bounds. Ignore isolated 2s outside the panels.
2. For every panel marker, recolor the entire in-bounds 3×3 neighborhood centered on it to color 1, including neighborhood cells that were 0; preserve every color-2 marker, including overlaps. Leave all other cells unchanged.
3. Validate that each changed cell lies within one marker’s 3×3 halo, every such cell except 2 is 1, outside 2s and unrelated cells remain unchanged, then check dimensions and submit.
